sentences.en: The money could take days to arrive at its destination.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱可能需要好几天才能到达目的地。

sentences.en: The city is gaining popularity as a major tourist destination.
sentences.zh: 这座城市因其作为主要旅游目的地而越来越受欢迎。

sentences.en: The man never told the police what his destination was.
sentences.zh: 那人从未告诉警方他的目的地是什么。
